business_ops.seasonality: The production and sale of technical textiles and consequently sales volumes may be affected by general economic or industry conditions, including seasonal trends in the agriculture sector, recessionary trends in the global and domestic economies and volatility in construction. The cyclical nature of the agriculture and construction industries, both globally and in India, impacts the demand for packaging of bulk commodities, which in turn affects demand for machinery and equipment for manufacturing technical textiles. In particular, the agricultural sector is inherently seasonal and is further impacted by factors including agricultural commodity prices, costs of fertilizers and adverse weather conditions. Similarly, the construction sector is prone to seasonality owing to factors such as the inconsistent real estate market and economic downturns that cease construction activity. No seasonality figures or quarterly split for the issuer's own revenue are disclosed in the routed text.
business_ops.supply_chain_integration: Backward integration capabilities reduce dependence on external supply of parts and components for machine manufacturing and support services and enable maintenance of quality control. The Company designs and manufactures inverters, customized machine controllers and motors along with other products for its circular weaving machine and winders, and operates its own surface mount technology manufacturing line for printed circuit board assembly and testing, so inverters, controllers and motors are made in-house for use either as original parts or spare parts. It has an in-house sheet metal fabrication shop catering to all sheet metal part requirements, 100 computer numerical control (CNC) machines that manufacture parts required in its machines, and a 3D coordinate measuring machine (CMM) from a global internal precision-equipment supplier for adherence to specifications. Electrical parts like inverters and printed circuit boards are also produced in-house using imported electric parts manufacturing equipment, aided by electrical assembly shops at each manufacturing facility where electrical panels are assembled. Other manufacturing steps are integrated through plating shops, moulding shops, assembly and testing shops and paint shops located within the manufacturing facilities, minimising dependence on external service providers. On the inbound side, raw materials, parts and components are sourced from suppliers on a purchase order basis, usually valid for one and two years, without formal long-term agreements; key externally sourced components include extrusion die, pump and screw, gear-box, bearings, electric motors and drives, and certain key components such as electrical motors, sensors, PLC systems, invertors and gear boxes are procured from limited suppliers in India, Europe, USA, China and Japan. Forward reach is through an exclusive global sales network: four sales offices in India (Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Kolkata, New Delhi) plus a corporate office, five international offices (Brazil, Russia, Thailand, UAE, USA), warehouses in India, UAE and USA, stockists in eight countries, 17 exclusive sales agents, and service engineers stationed in 12 cities in India and in 12 countries overseas.

overview.business_model: The Company manufactures and sells machinery and equipment used to make woven plastic (Raffia) fabric and sacks - tape extrusion lines, winders, circular looms, coating and lamination lines, printing machines, conversion machines, multifilament yarn machines, twister winders, monofilament extrusion lines and recycling machines - to a global customer base through an extensive global sales and distribution network.

genesis.founding_story: The Company was incorporated as "Kanpur Packaging Machines Limited", a company limited by shares, under the Companies Act, pursuant to a certificate of incorporation dated June 5, 2023 issued by the Registrar of Companies, Central Registration Center. The Company had no operations since its incorporation on June 5, 2023 and prior to the Scheme being effective.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: We manufacture a comprehensive and diverse suite of machinery such as tape extrusion lines, circular loom, coating and lamination lines, printing machines, conversion machines, multifilament yarn machines, twister winders, monofilament extrusion lines and recycling machines, amongst others, as well as spare parts.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: We provide end-to-end solutions for the entire ecosystem of woven fabric, offering services from ‘concept to commissioning’, throughout the complete production lifecycle required for the Raffia industry.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: We manufacture winders and rewinders for high performance fibres and we have also ventured into extrusion lines to produce technical monofilaments with diversified applications such as textiles, agriculture and sports.

other_material_facts.label: material fact

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: Of our Indian manufacturing facilities, two are located in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh along with the live experience centre (where we manufacture FIBCs), and two are located in Bengaluru, Karnataka.

other_material_facts.label: material fact
other_material_facts.value: We operate the Hargovind Bajaj R&D Centre, a research and development centre in Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh, that is accredited by the Department of Scientific and Industrial Research, Ministry of Science and Technology, Government of India.

other_material_facts.label: material fact

cost_leadership.title: Supply chain integration (RHP report)
cost_leadership.body: Backward integration capabilities reduce dependence on external supply of parts and components for machine manufacturing and support services and enable maintenance of quality control. The Company designs and manufactures inverters, customized machine controllers and motors along with other products for its circular weaving machine and winders, and operates its own surface mount technology manufacturing line for printed circuit board assembly and testing, so inverters, controllers and motors are made in-house for use either as original parts or spare parts. It has an in-house sheet metal fabrication shop catering to all sheet metal part requirements, 100 computer numerical control (CNC) machines that manufacture parts required in its machines, and a 3D coordinate measuring machine (CMM) from a global internal precision-equipment supplier for adherence to specifications. Electrical parts like inverters and printed circuit boards are also produced in-house using imported electric parts manufacturing equipment, aided by electrical assembly shops at each manufacturing facility where electrical panels are assembled. Other manufacturing steps are integrated through plating shops, moulding shops, assembly and testing shops and paint shops located within the manufacturing facilities, minimising dependence on external service providers. On the inbound side, raw materials, parts and components are sourced from suppliers on a purchase order basis, usually valid for one and two years, without formal long-term agreements; key externally sourced components include extrusion die, pump and screw, gear-box, bearings, electric motors and drives, and certain key components such as electrical motors, sensors, PLC systems, invertors and gear boxes are procured from limited suppliers in India, Europe, USA, China and Japan. Forward reach is through an exclusive global sales network: four sales offices in India (Ahmedabad, Bengaluru, Kolkata, New Delhi) plus a corporate office, five international offices (Brazil, Russia, Thailand, UAE, USA), warehouses in India, UAE and USA, stockists in eight countries, 17 exclusive sales agents, and service engineers stationed in 12 cities in India and in 12 countries overseas.

demand_drivers.title: Seasonality (RHP report)
demand_drivers.body: The production and sale of technical textiles and consequently sales volumes may be affected by general economic or industry conditions, including seasonal trends in the agriculture sector, recessionary trends in the global and domestic economies and volatility in construction. The cyclical nature of the agriculture and construction industries, both globally and in India, impacts the demand for packaging of bulk commodities, which in turn affects demand for machinery and equipment for manufacturing technical textiles. In particular, the agricultural sector is inherently seasonal and is further impacted by factors including agricultural commodity prices, costs of fertilizers and adverse weather conditions. Similarly, the construction sector is prone to seasonality owing to factors such as the inconsistent real estate market and economic downturns that cease construction activity. No seasonality figures or quarterly split for the issuer's own revenue are disclosed in the routed text.
